user.title: Set up Custom OpenAI AI Tasks
user.description: Enter your OpenAI-compatible server URL, API key, and model(s). At least one model must be configured. The URL may be the server root (http://host:8000) or include /v1 - requests go to /v1/chat/completions with Bearer auth.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Custom OpenAI AI Tasks
reconfigure.description: Update your OpenAI-compatible server URL, API key, and model(s). At least one model must be configured. The URL may be the server root (http://host:8000) or include /v1.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect - check the endpoint URL and API key
error.no_models_configured: At least one model (chat or image) must be configured

init.title: Custom OpenAI AI Tasks Options
init.description: Configure your preferred models. At least one model must be configured.

error.no_models_configured: At least one model (chat or image) must be configured

migrate_downgrade.title: Custom OpenAI AI Tasks cannot read its saved configuration
migrate_downgrade.description: The saved configuration for "{title}" was written by a newer version of Custom OpenAI AI Tasks (version {entry_version}); this version understands up to version {supported_version}. This usually means Custom OpenAI AI Tasks was downgraded. Update it back to the newer version, or remove and re-add the integration.

migrate_incomplete_config.title: Custom OpenAI AI Tasks needs its endpoint and API key again

confirm.title: Retry the Custom OpenAI AI Tasks update
confirm.description: "{title}" has no endpoint or API key saved, so it could not finish updating. Reconfigure it first (Settings > Devices & Services > Custom OpenAI AI Tasks > Configure), then submit this to try again.

migrate_incomplete_config_restart.title: Custom OpenAI AI Tasks needs its endpoint and API key again
migrate_incomplete_config_restart.description: "{title}" has no endpoint or API key saved, so Custom OpenAI AI Tasks could not finish updating it. Reconfigure it (Settings > Devices & Services > Custom OpenAI AI Tasks > Configure), then restart Home Assistant to finish the update.

migrate_downgrade.message: The saved configuration for "{title}" is version {entry_version}, but this version of Custom OpenAI AI Tasks only understands up to version {supported_version}.

migrate_incomplete_config.message: "{title}" has no endpoint or API key saved, so it could not finish updating.

migrate_transient.message: Could not save the updated Custom OpenAI AI Tasks configuration; this will be retried.
